'''Godan-Ur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Adjudicators|Adjudicator]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he presided over a hearing between Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]], Imperial Ambassador [[Methias Yoran]] and the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]. After Redrish defended her position by announcing a pilgrimage to the [[Shrine of Healing]], Godan-Ur determined that the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] should take the pilgrimage as well.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Godan-Ur appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Bounty Hunter class mission on Voss.
